'''Hualin''' is an NPC in {{Location|Lake Heights}}.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Hualin}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the day)
:'''Hualin:''' Hello? Can I help you?
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing here?
:'''Hualin:''' Nothing really. Just keeping my daughter company.
:'''Hualin:''' Just like everyone else here, being here makes me feel closer to her.

;(During the night)
:'''Hualin:''' Hello... You must be a thoughtful person to come here this late.
:{{DIcon}} You look very sad.
:'''Hualin:''' It's okay. Having [[Yangming]] with me at night makes it a bit easier than the day.
:{{DIcon}} Is Yangming your grandson?
:'''Hualin:''' Yes, he comes here almost every day to talk to his mother.
:'''Hualin:''' I stay with him too. Sometimes we spend the whole night here...
:{{DIcon}} Are you all right?
:'''Hualin:''' It'd be a sleepless night at home anyway... might as well stay here a bit longer with them.
{{Dialogue End}}
